mappings.meaning: Draw a competition menu label with selection-dependent palette.
Commit the selected or unselected label palette.
Shared drawing entry for selectable and fixed-palette menu labels.
Toggle item availability and blink its cursor on menu options0 or1.
Choose the items cursor X position from the toggle state.
Store cursor X and draw only on one half of frame-counter bit3.
Shared hidden/inapplicable return for the items cursor.
7-entry fixed-slot actor initialization list for CompetitionMenu_ActorRecords.
Select the character icon for Player1 or Player2 on results rows.
Commit the selected player character frame before scroll-aware drawing.
Select each player result icon from the two race-win counters.
Compare own and opposing race-win counts for a result icon.
Translate the non-tie comparison branch into win/loss frame.
Store result frame and blink only the winning icon.
8-entry fixed-slot actor initialization list for CompetitionResults_ActorRecords.
Initialize the character icon for one of three saved time-attack records.
Select the saved-record character frame and install its blink updater.
Blink the record icon whose row matches the newly achieved top-record index.
Draw the saved character icon for a time-attack record.
Skip drawing the newly matched record icon during the hidden blink half.
